title: Handoff demo day
description: A synthetic clinic day seeded relative to 'now'. P12 is the hero: misrouted to consultation, lab report unreviewed, handoff dropped, auto-flagged.

hero.name: Meera Krishnan
hero.reason: Came about my blood report, my name is printed wrong
story: arrived 58 min ago about a report correction
reception guessed and routed her to consultation (misroute)
consulted, lab ordered, sample taken, result ready 26 min ago
doctor never accepted the lab->clinician review handoff (SLA 5 min)
watchdog flagged her BLOCKED_NO_OWNER at ~21 min orphan time

expected.resolution: accept handoff -> READY_FOR_PICKUP, alerts clear, waits-with-owner 100%

background_cast: 10 completed patients (P01,P04,P06,P08,P11,P13,P15,P16,P17,P18) provide stage-duration distributions for p50/p90 and ETAs.
demo_beats: Dashboard: ask 'who is P12 waiting on?' — red flagged card answers.
Open her modal: full timeline shows misroute + 3 interruptions + flagged event.
Patient page /patient?pid=P12: plain-language status, ETA, EN/HI toggle.
Manager agent: 'Where did waiting time go today?' returns bottlenecks + recommendation + tool trace.
Resolve handoff: watch flagged -> front desk pickup, 86% -> 100% owned, orphan minutes -> 0.
